name: slskd
shortDescription: DroppedNeedle with a bundled slskd Soulseek client that downloads into the same media volume, so requested albums are fetched, verified and filed in your library.

alerts.message: The first account created in the web UI becomes the admin, so open the app right after deploying. Then add /data/music under Settings > Library and, under Settings > Download Client, connect slskd with URL http://droppedneedle-slskd:5030 and the generated SLSKD_API_KEY.

slskd only joins Soulseek once you set your Soulseek account in SLSKD_SLSK_USERNAME and SLSKD_SLSK_PASSWORD. It shares SLSKD_SHARED_DIR (the library at /data/music by default) with the network, and Soulseek bans clients that share nothing.
Only DroppedNeedle is routed. The slskd web UI and the Soulseek listen port 50300 stay private, so peers that cannot accept incoming connections either may fail to transfer.
